about_the_game:
Power. Honor. Endurance. Equip yourself like a true champion of Iveria.

Step into the battlefield fully armed with the Warrior Equipment Package, a powerful gear collection crafted for battle-hardened heroes in 4Story: The Original. This DLC is designed for those who fight at the frontlines and need the strength of steel, the favor of the gods, and the tools to turn the tide of war.

Includes the following exclusive set items:

  • Guidance of Goddess – A divine one-handed sword, empowering the warrior’s spirit with increased durability and resilience.

  • Blessing of Palkenhein – A sacred two-handed sword, said to channel the grace of the celestial realm.

  • Lahoor Clan Slayer – A brutal two-handed axe forged for a single purpose: to crush the dark ambitions of the Lahoor Clan.

  • Bow of Rainstorm – A tactical long-range weapon that unleashes a downpour of arrows, striking enemies with relentless fury.

  • Time and Space Destroyer – A mysterious blade infused with temporal energy, capable of distorting reality with each strike.

  • Ruler Shield – A mighty shield carried by the sovereign defenders of Iveria, providing unmatched defense in battle.

Iron Will Heavy Armor Set:

  • Heavy Helm of Iron Will

  • Heavy Chest of Iron Will

  • Heavy Leggings of Iron Will

  • Heavy Gloves of Iron Will

  • Heavy Boots of Iron Will

A full-body armor ensemble forged for unyielding warriors. Built to endure the harshest blows and command the frontlines with unwavering determination.

Forge your legacy with the Warrior Equipment Package—gear worthy of legends, available now as part of your journey through 4Story: The Original.

*You must enter the game, open the premium shop and click on the DLC banner to receive the set item.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Pentium 4 1.6 GHZ or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel I3 6 Gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
